name: Corvus A (Hubble)
blurb: Corvus A, a small isolated dwarf galaxy just beyond the Local Group, seen by Hubble.
label: corvus-hubble
story: Corvus A is a lonely little galaxy with no larger neighbor, holding a mix of young and old stars. Hubble resolved its stars and found that it appears to have only recently stopped forming new ones.

claims.text: The target CORVUS of program 17514 is the galaxy Corvus A
Corvus A is a low-mass, gas-rich dwarf galaxy
Corvus A is isolated, with no known galaxy nearby
Corvus A has no larger neighboring galaxy and ranks among the most isolated faint dwarfs
Corvus A lies just beyond the Local Group
Corvus A contains a mix of young and old stars
Corvus A appears to have recently stopped forming stars
